module: Node "Has Coupler Tag" (category `repeat_instant`, tags event/attach/detach). Indicates whether a vehicle has couplers carrying certain tags: `tow_hitch`, `fifthwheel`, `gooseneck_hitch`, `fifthwheel_v2`, `pintle` (list in the file). Input pin: `vehA`. One bool output per tag (pins created dynamically from the list).
notes: Crashes if `vehA` matches no vehicle known to the vehicle module (`getVehicle` returns nil): no test.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStarted.desc: Sets all tag outputs to false.

work.desc: Reads the vehicle's `couplerTags` in the manager's vehicle module and fills each output.
